subject: Andrews Middle School Student Podcast Project
overview: Eighth-grade teacher Amelia Whalen discussed her students' award-winning podcast project and its influence on district dress code policy. The conversation also addressed the pandemic's impact on student development and the climate of teacher contract negotiations.

items.title: Teaching Philosophy and Background
items.summary: Amelia Whalen discussed her path to education and her focus on using literature to help students develop their voices and evaluate hypothetical scenarios.

items.title: Student Advocacy and NPR Recognition
items.summary: A student-led podcast advocating for dress code reform achieved a national runner-up award and successfully prompted revisions to the district's policy on hats and hoods.

items.title: Classroom Podcast Methodology
items.summary: Whalen detailed the five-year history of the podcast project, including the student-led process of brainstorming, committee voting, and synthesizing research.

items.title: Teacher Contract Negotiations
items.summary: Whalen described the emotional frustration surrounding current teacher contract negotiations while noting that student enthusiasm helps sustain educator morale.

items.title: Pandemic Impact and Educational Transition
items.summary: The discussion addressed the unique social and academic challenges faced by eighth graders who navigated the middle school transition during the pandemic.
